description: Prepare the video (or just the part between start and end) and return a short gimmeclip.com/w/… link anyone can open and play, kept for 30 days. Counts against the caller's daily limit (40 per IP, 200 with an API key) unless the same clip was shared before. If it returns a job_id, call share_video again with that job_id to keep waiting.

end.description: Optional: end of the part to keep, in seconds (after start).

item.description: Which video of a multi-video post (1-based); see get_video_info.

job_id.description: Only to resume: job_id from an earlier share_video call that was still preparing.

quality.description: Resolution cap (the smaller side, so vertical videos count the same).

start.description: Optional: start of the part to keep, in seconds.

url.description: Link to a public post or video (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick).

name: share_video
title: Make a watch link
